Subject: Stakeholder map & MAP next steps

Hi Sarah —

Thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap from our call and proposed next steps so we have aligned action items: 

1) Stakeholder map (who we identified on the call):
   - Economic buyer: Michael Carter (CFO) — interested in TCO and runway impact
   - Procurement: Tom Richards — contracting and procurement timeline
   - Security/Infosec: Anika Desai — SOC 2, data residency, encryption
   - Legal: (TBD) — contract language, data processing addendum
   - Product/Engineering champion: Sarah Lawson — integration & evaluation criteria

2) Decision criteria you called out: latency under 300ms for key flows, predictable monthly committed pricing, ability to run in a private VPC for PCI scope reduction, and SLAs for availability.

3) Proposed MAP (mutual action plan) milestones — I can draft and share a template by Thursday:
   - Draft MAP + stakeholder contact list (Marissa) — by 2027-06-03
   - Security questionnaire + evidence (FinPay) — target 2027-06-10
   - Technical evaluation (Redwood PoC) — kickoff 2027-06-14, 2 weeks
   - Commercial proposal & procurement review — target 2027-06-28

Next steps: I will send a MAP template and attach a short platform overview. Can you confirm Tom and Anika as the procurement and security contacts? Also please let me know who should be on the legal thread so we can include the right reviewers.

Thanks —
Marissa
Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0182
